subjective.text: Barbara has had diarrhoea for three days with watery stools and vomiting.
Barbara's brother also has similar symptoms.
Barbara takes vitamin D daily and occasionally ibuprofen for menstrual cramps.
Barbara lives with her brother and mother.
Barbara has missed work due to the illness.

objective.text: Barbara's abdomen is sore around the navel area, causing urges to go to the toilet.
Barbara cannot touch her navel area due to pain.
Barbara has had a temperature and vomits everything she takes.
Barbara's urine color is not noticeable.
Barbara passed urine an hour ago.

assessment.text: Barbara has infectious gastroenteritis possibly caused by a virus.
Barbara needs to be hydrated with oral rehydration salts and have her hydration checked.

plan.text: Prescribe oral rehydration salts; advise small sips of water frequently to avoid vomiting.
Recommend simple food like toast or biscuits if eating anything.
Book an urgent appointment for a stool sample and hydration check.
Instruct to call back if feeling worse; consider A&E visit if not better in a day.
